summary: The code is syntactically correct and imports are fine, but it does not fully implement the specified Mask Adoption Dynamics Simulation. Key entities/attributes and behaviors (notably disease transmission, full policy and supply features, and most metrics) are missing or only partially implemented. Some logic and performance concerns also exist. The required direct main() call pattern is satisfied.

issues.description: Missing epidemiological dynamics (disease transmission, become_infected, recover) and associated attributes/parameters (health_state, vaccination_status, mask efficacy inward/outward) required by the specification.
issues.location: Simulation.step (no infection process), Individual (missing infection-related attributes), DEFAULT_CONFIG (no transmission loop despite parameters in the task spec)
issues.solution: Add an infection state machine (e.g., SIR/SEIR) per Person with health_state and vaccination_status; implement disease_transmission during location interactions using contact_rate, location transmission modifiers, and mask efficacy_outward/inward effects; update recoveries and importation events.

issues.description: Person entity is missing several required attributes and behaviors from the spec (gender, occupation, essential_worker, adoption_state vs. current_mask_use naming, mask_type, contact_rate, mobility_pattern, information_exposure, policy_awareness).
issues.solution: Extend Individual with the missing attributes and align naming (e.g., adoption_state, trust_in_authorities). Incorporate these into decision logic (e.g., essential_worker affects exposure and mandate compliance; mobility_pattern instead of single mobility_level).

issues.description: Metrics required by the specification are not computed; only time series are tracked. Missing metrics include time_to_50_percent_adoption, peak_adoption, sustained_adoption_duration, infection_attack_rate, effective_reproduction_number, cases_averted, compliance_by_location_type, equity_gap_in_adoption, inventory_outage_days, enforcement_actions_count, misinformation_prevalence, and cost_per_additional_adopter.
issues.location: Simulation (no finalize or metrics computation method)
issues.solution: Add a finalize_metrics() method to compute metrics after running: derive times to thresholds from adoption_rate series; compute peak and sustained periods; aggregate enforcement events; compute compliance_by_location_type from visits_* counters; compute equity metrics across demographic subgroups; and if infection dynamics are added, compute attack rate, Rt, and cases averted vs. baseline.

issues.description: Supply and retailer behaviors lack rationing and price control features specified (rationing_rule, rationing_limit_per_purchase, set_price_controls).
issues.solution: Implement rationing rules in Retailer.sell/purchase paths respecting a per-purchase limit. Add Government.set_price_controls to cap prices and/or subsidize costs, and integrate it into Retailer.adjust_price_based_on_inventory.

issues.description: Location attributes and behaviors are incomplete relative to spec (missing transmission_modifier, mandate_level, operating_hours; host_interactions not implemented).
issues.solution: Add fields transmission_modifier, mandate_level, operating_hours; implement host_interactions to produce interaction counts based on capacity, operating hours, and crowding. Use transmission_modifier in disease transmission calculations.

issues.description: Mandate scope by location type (e.g., indoor_public) is not modeled; mandate currently applies globally without respecting scope.
issues.solution: Add mandate_scope configuration and apply it to relevant location types (e.g., stores, transit, leisure) when determining requirement_active and enforcement.

issues.description: Stockout and inventory outage days are tracked inconsistently; counters (stockout_days, retailer_stockout_days) are defined but never incremented; any_stockout is appended but not summarized.
issues.solution: Increment stockout_days or retailer_stockout_days when any_stockout flag is set. Summarize inventory outages in finalize_metrics().

issues.description: allow_or_deny_entry always returns True, so mandates cannot deny entry, and enforcement has limited effect beyond fines.
issues.solution: Implement denial of entry logic based on enforcement_level and compliance, aligned with policy_enforcement interaction.

issues.description: Information flow mechanisms (Media, interpersonal) are simplified; missing Media.bias/trustworthiness/reach and broadcast_misinformation behaviors as per spec.
issues.solution: Expand MediaChannel with bias, trustworthiness, reach, and explicit broadcast_information/misinformation methods. Apply reach to a sampled subset of the population, modulating their risk_perception and trust_in_authorities.

issues.description: Per-day neighbor correlation and social influence passes iterate over all edges; for population_size=10000 and average_degree=10 these O(E) computations repeated multiple times per day can be heavy.
issues.location: Simulation._neighbor_influence_corr and social info-sharing loop in step()
issues.solution: Compute neighbor_corr less frequently (e.g., weekly) or sample a subset; consider using adjacency in numpy for vectorized operations; gate expensive diagnostics with a config flag.

issues.description: Unused imports (csv, matplotlib) and optional plotting not used in the code.
issues.solution: Remove unused imports or implement optional visualization guarded by a config flag to justify the dependency.

issues.description: Main function does nothing; while the required call pattern is satisfied, it provides no entrypoint behavior.
issues.solution: Optionally, make main() parse a config, run Simulation, and print/save key outputs. Not required by the sandbox, but improves usability.

issues.description: Purchase logic always attempts to buy at most one mask per event and ignores rationing_limit_per_purchase from the spec.
issues.solution: Incorporate a demand model that allows up to rationing_limit_per_purchase masks per transaction with demand driven by price and inventory expectations.

issues.description: No computation of compliance_by_location_type and equity_gap_in_adoption metrics despite collecting partial counters.
issues.solution: Compute compliance_by_location_type as shares from visits_* counters; compute equity_gap as differences between subgroup adoption rates (e.g., income deciles, age, essential worker status) in finalize_metrics().
